text:
This looks like a tray after a meal, so only leftovers remain. The plate itself holds just residue: some brown sauce or gravy and a bit of green, perhaps guacamole or a vegetable. That is roughly 10 g and 20 kcal.

The bowl has a few pieces of fruit, apple and melon or similar, about 60 g and 30 kcal.

The small cups hold a green sauce, a dark sauce and a pink or red sauce, probably gelatin or jam. At about 10 g each, that is 30 g and 30 kcal.

The glass of cola is a drink rather than food on the plate, so I left it out.

Adding the plate residue, the fruit and the cups gives about 100 g and 80 kcal.

{"kcal": 80, "mass_g": 100}
